    if v is None:

        try:
            n = float(s)
            if math.isfinite(n):

        except Exception:

        return ("str", s.lower())
    if isinstance(v, bool):
        return ("bool", v)
    if isinstance(v, (int, float)) and not isinstance(v, bool):
